## 1. The offline replay -- Rule EPS over every recorded A211 g1 node (`results/eps227.jsonl`)

`epsscan227.py ALL --run g1_page` puts each node's recorded pose set (padded outward, as `snapscan224`) through the
rule; a row per node with at least one near-simple (role, forced cell) candidate (A224's filter).

| measure | value |
|---|---|
| pages with a candidate node | 1 |
| nodes with a candidate | 75 |
| candidate (role, slot) evaluations | 101 |
| **nodes DEAD by FC+EPS** | **0** |
| nodes where a candidate lost >= 1 meeter without dying | 75 |
| candidates by number of roles struck | 3 struck: 55, 4 struck: 46 |
| anonymous clause (per candidate) | none: 101 |
| replay seconds (sum) | 3.5 |

**Survivor sets** (the roles that can still reach a wedge target, per candidate):

| survivors | candidates |
|---|---|
| F3, H | 55 |
| H | 46 |

**Which target the survivor reaches** (role, first reachable target family):

| role | target | count |
|---|---|---|
| H | wedge-L | 55 |
| H | wedge-R | 45 |
| F3 | wedge-T | 36 |
| F3 | wedge-L | 19 |
| H | wedge-T | 1 |
